summary: All 34 hashes match. Existing source, terminal outputs and recovery receipts support four full-9508 C-off metric rows, three completed epochs/13749 updates and exact cold restoration of stored model/AdamW/scheduler/global RNG state. E0 remains best; no net continuation gain. Evidence does not establish new accuracy, causal C effects, archive completion or overall goal completion.

The historical C-on E3 pair exists only in a summary within this input set. Its -5/+31 comparison is arithmetic on unverified baseline inputs, not a freshly verified baseline result or causal C evidence. Prior learned initialization prevents any never-C interpretation.

The full 1080178-byte train log and training annotation inventory are unbound; the 40000-byte tail starts at final-validation batch 555/1189. audit_method: Read all 34 bound text files directly; SHA-256, JSON consistency and arithmetic with Python standard library only. No SSH, weight loading, neural imports, dataset construction, tests, GPU calls, new jobs or source changes.

input_hashes.details: All 34 bound existing paths were read; 365115 bytes total. Every SHA-256 matches AUDIT_INPUTS.json. Every key equals Python Path.resolve(). Fourteen CONTROL_PREPARATION source pins, two bound helper pins, and all five observation file size/hash bindings also agree.

gt_provenance.details: Source-level real-GT chain: ScanRefer_filtered_val JSON/TXT supplies scene/object IDs; val_v3scans.pkl supplies Scan objects; target boxes come from scan.get_object_bbox(target_id), masks from annotated instance points. GroundingEvaluator reads center_label/size_gts, not prediction-derived reference. Model inputs use GroupFree predicted detections, with butd_gt and butd_cls false. Dataset asset bytes and Scan implementation are outside these 34 inputs, so original benchmark-byte provenance is not newly attested.

score_normalization.details: Primary hits are counts of GT boxes with top-1 IoU strictly greater than 0.25/0.50. Denominator is number of evaluated GT targets, asserted to be 9508 for both thresholds. Softmax is candidate token scoring; geometry normalization and training losses are not the reported accuracy denominator. All percentages exactly equal 100*hits/9508.

result_existence.details: native_metrics.jsonl contains E0/E1/E2/E3. Its records agree with controller.log, normal_status.json, observation and summary; summary percentages and E0 deltas recompute exactly. Terminal train.exit and observation exit are zero. E3 raw log reaches 1189/1189, prints 0.58593/0.47528, and saves latest.pth. Only the narrow current C-off records are accepted; historical C-on numbers lack bound primary evidence.

dead_code.details: The claimed last/bbs path is live: main calls evaluate_one_epoch; it instantiates GroundingEvaluator and calls evaluate for last_; that invokes bbox/mask position and semantic routines. E3 logger output corroborates execution. Proposal and 0head-4head printed zeroes are unevaluated accumulator placeholders because the loop skips non-last prefixes; they are not measured results. calculate_diou_3d is defined but only a commented call exists, and no DIoU result is claimed.

same_complete_model_and_checkpoint_selec.details: Both primary thresholds are accumulated from one model evaluation and returned as one metric record. The loop does not reload or choose a different checkpoint by threshold. Complete checkpoints serialize all model state and retain a single metric pair. Initial construction explicitly combines pinned official/G/support/span learned components; this is disclosed initialization, not a claim of single-source pretraining. No score or per-example checkpoint splice is observed in the audited path.

epochs_and_update_budget.details: Protocol and actual child argv specify start_epoch=1, max_epoch=3, B=8, seed=2027; no resume or preflight checkpoint is passed. The source performs one optimizer.step per training batch. Terminal has E0-E3 and exit 0; the recovery receipt reads saved_epoch=3 and 820 optimizer states with sole step value 13749, matching 3*4583. Accepted as source/receipt-supported completion. The bound 40000-byte log tail covers only final validation; the advertised 36665 train expression count is expected, not independently recounted from dataset bytes here.

Protocol/controller hashes match admission; protocol arguments match start and terminal argv, and launch admission equals collected admission. The 34-file set does not contain init.json, env_spec.json, NATIVE_SOURCE_PORT.json, wandb_config.yaml or the full imported runtime. cold_recovery.details: Existing recovery execution is receipt-supported, not rerun in this audit. The helper hashes each entire checkpoint, creates new native model/AdamW/scheduler objects, uses DDP and native load_checkpoint, and compares all 1295 model state entries, optimizer groups/state entries, scheduler state, start epoch and Python/NumPy/Torch CPU/all CUDA RNG states. Receipt reports exact recovery for E0 best and E3 latest with exit 0. E0 has zero optimizer states because it was saved before the first update; E3 has 820 states at step 13749. No forward, resumed batch, update or accuracy replay was performed.

scope.details: One C-off continuation arm, one seed 2027, one ScanRefer validation set, four epoch evaluations. This is not training from scratch or a never-C initialization: learned official/G/support/span components and prior span training are disclosed. No C-on primary terminal record, multi-seed robustness, three effective mechanism proof, or completed full Nr3D/Sr3D experiment is bound. No local archive completion evidence is bound. Current overall project goal remains ACTIVE_UNMET.

evaluation_type.details: The recorded ScanRefer evaluations use dataset-provided GT. The audit itself is static verification of existing source/results/receipts. Checkpoint recovery is engineering state restoration and produces no new accuracy; it is not a simulated benchmark.

accepted_claims.claim: All 34 exact bound inputs and the internal source/helper/observation hashes checked in this audit are consistent.
Existing native ScanRefer last/bbs records report E0 5677/4920, E1 5644/4604, E2 5615/4598 and E3 5571/4519, with 9508 GT targets per row and both thresholds from the same complete model evaluation.
The existing C-off ordinary continuation completed three epochs with total 13749 AdamW steps (3*4583), supported by terminal exit and recovered epoch/optimizer state.
E0 remains the retained best. E3 is lower by 106/401 hits and this continuation produced no net gain over E0.

Existing recovery receipts support cold rebuilding and exact stored-state restoration of both best(E0) and latest(E3): model, AdamW, scheduler, start epoch and Python/NumPy/Torch CPU/CUDA RNG. No new forward/update/accuracy evaluation was performed.

No prediction-statistic accuracy normalization or threshold-specific checkpoint/score splice is observed in the bound primary evaluation code. Initialization from learned component parents is explicitly disclosed.
